name: smwpatches-all-yoshi-coin-status-bar
title: All Yoshi Coin Status Bar
description:
After collecting 5 or more Yoshi coins, this patch will write "ALL0" (0 = symbol for YC) in place of the 4 coins.
This will also be displayed if you reenter the level.
What the patch writes or does after having collected 5+ Yoshi coins can easily be changed in the .asm file. (See the readme for further information on this)
